main.description: The repositories a pull into a repository can come from, itself and its forks, and, given a branch, what that branch has since it left the base, as a pull from it would show. No authentication; responses are not personalized.

errors.description: No such repository, or no such branch on either.
errors.name: NotFound

changes.description: What the branch brings in, given one.

heads.description: The repositories a pull can come from: this one first, then its forks the index knows, oldest first.

base.description: The branch to merge into; the default branch if not given.

branch.description: The branch to bring in. Without one, only the repositories are answered.

head.description: The repository the branch is on: this one, if not given, or a fork of it.

repo.description: The repository to merge into: its dev.knotless.repo record. Its authority may be a handle.

description: What a pull from a branch would bring into a repository, before it is opened.
